arguments.sql:
SELECT p.page_id, p.page_name, t.event_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM main.shopping_cart_events AS e
JOIN main.shopping_cart_page_hierarchy AS p ON p.page_id = e.page_id
JOIN main.shopping_cart_event_identifier AS t ON t.event_type = e.event_type
GROUP BY p.page_id, p.page_name, t.event_name
ORDER BY p.page_id, t.event_name

JOIN main.shopping_cart_event_identifier AS t ON t.event_type = e.event_type
